Maia (Marketing): Quick thread: we need to finalize copy variants for the tri-mode landing + webinar push. Want to run a tiny voice experiment: outcome-led vs technical-led heroes. Thoughts?
Jonah (Growth): love it. outcome-led sample: "Ship AI features fast, lower cost per convo." technical-led sample: "Same API. Multiple deployment modes. Deterministic performance."
Pri (PM): webinar is the conversion driver for Dedicated. Ask registrants: deployment interest + primary workload (chat/search/embeddings). Use answers to set lead_score and route.
Arden (Design): I'll build two hero treatments: one with human-centric imagery for outcome-led, one with schematic stack art for technical-led. Mobile-first spacing confirmed.
Soren (EngOps): routing/webhook needs: field slugs = deployment_interest, workload_type, variant_id. Example payload I'll consume:
```
utm_source: tri_launch
deployment_interest: dedicated
workload_type: search
variant_id: V2
```
Jonah (Growth): for socials I want two caption sets. X (short): "One API. Any deployment. See our benchmarks + migration playbook. <link> #LLM #inference" LinkedIn (long): "Redwood Inference now supports Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployment modes with a single API. Join our webinar for benchmark demos and a migration playbook tailored for platform teams and security-conscious orgs. <link>"
Maia (Marketing): also draft a community post for DEV/ Hacker News style: include a small technical appendix in the webinar (latency, cost/token, cache hit impact) and invite questions for the Q&A.
Arden (Design): CTA A/B test options: A="Register  See Benchmarks" B="Register  Get the Migration Playbook". I'll wire variant tracking on the page.
Soren (EngOps): I'll attach tags: interest:hosted|dedicated|private and variant:A|B and push to CRM. Also propose an extra hidden field `prod_scale` with options: PoC / Pilot / Production for prioritization.
Pri (PM): good idea. we'll prioritize demo invites for `Production` + `dedicated` leads. Maia, can you steward the webinar slide that shows a conservative benchmark (example: 30% unit-cost reduction with caching + batching on Dedicated for a 5k-token search flow)? Keep numbers framed as "early customer observed".
Maia (Marketing): noted — "early customer observed" it is. I'll draft landing microcopy now and post below for quick review.
remind-bot: Reminder set for Friday 2024-06-21 09:00:00 PT  Webinar dry run.
Maia (Marketing): Landing microcopy draft: "Deliver production-grade inference on the stack you control. Use a single API to run on Hosted for rapid launches, Dedicated for throughput guarantees, or Private inside your network. Join our webinar for benchmark demos and a migration playbook to move from proof-of-concept to production." 
Jonah (Growth): tweak hero shorter for banner: "One API. Any deployment. Production-ready inference." 
Arden (Design): uploading hero comps and variant assets to #design-assets now. will tag mobile spacing notes.
Maia (Marketing): action list: 1) Arden finalize hero assets 2) Soren confirm webhook + form slugs 3) Jonah draft X + LinkedIn posts 4) Pri finalize speakers and slide on conservative benchmark. Reconvene Fri morning for dry run. :white_check_mark:
